text: I got the news this morning: we're having a baby! I can't stop smiling, I called everyone I know.
Best day in ages. The whole team clapped when the launch went live and I actually danced in the kitchen after.
We finally got the keys to the flat. I ran through every empty room laughing like a kid.
My neighbour brought soup when she heard I was ill. I'm so thankful to have people like that around me.
Thinking about how much my sister has done for me this year. I don't say it enough, but I'm really grateful for her.
The bus driver waited for me in the rain and I nearly cried. Small kindnesses like that carry me.
Sat by the window with tea and did nothing for an hour. The house was quiet and nothing needed me.
Slow morning. Watered the plants, no phone, just the sound of the fan. I feel very settled.
Walked along the river at dusk. Everything felt still and unhurried, my mind was quiet for once.
Ordinary good day. Finished my work, cooked dinner, read a chapter. Nothing special, and that's fine with me.
I'm happy with how things are right now. The job is steady, the flat is warm, and dinner was decent.
Nice easy Sunday. Laundry done, called Mum, watched a film. I have what I need.
Woke up at six and went for a run before I even thought about it. I feel like I could take on anything today.
Had a burst of energy after the workout and rewrote the whole plan for the project in one sitting. So fired up!
I'm buzzing. Three hours of climbing and I still want to go out tonight, I have so much energy.
The interview went better than I expected. I don't know yet, but I really think this could be the start of something.
The test results aren't in, but the doctor sounded optimistic. I'm allowing myself to believe things will get better.
I sent the application today. Whatever happens, I feel like the door is finally opening and I'm looking forward to it.
I can't stop thinking about tomorrow's presentation. My stomach is in knots and my heart keeps racing.
Waiting on the biopsy results. Every time my phone buzzes I freeze. I keep imagining the worst.
Couldn't sleep, kept running through everything that might go wrong at the meeting. I feel on edge all day.
Too much at once: the deadline, the move, my mum's appointment and the tax forms. I don't know where to start and everything is piling up.
I looked at my list and just froze. There's so much to do that I can't even pick one thing. I'm drowning.
Three projects due, guests arriving Friday, and the car broke down. It's all too much and I can't keep up.
The landlord ignored me for the fourth time. I'm so annoyed I could scream. Nothing gets done unless I chase it.
Spent all afternoon on a bug that turned out to be a typo. I'm furious with myself and with this whole slow system.
He interrupted me again in the meeting and nobody said anything. I'm fed up with being talked over.
I have nothing left. Back-to-back shifts all week and my body feels like lead. I just want to sleep for a year.
Exhausted. Even making tea felt like too much effort today. I'm completely worn out.
Got home and sat in the car for twenty minutes because I had no energy to open the door. I'm spent.
I miss Dad so much today. Found his old scarf in a drawer and cried for an hour.
My best friend moved away and the flat feels empty. I keep feeling a heavy ache in my chest.
Didn't get in. I thought I'd be fine but I just feel very sad and small tonight.
I don't feel anything about it. Everyone says I should be upset or happy, but it's just blank. Like I'm behind glass.
Went through the day on autopilot. Nothing landed, not good, not bad. I feel flat and empty.
People talk to me and I nod. I can't tell what I feel, or if I feel anything at all.
Wir bekommen ein Baby! Ich habe den ganzen Tag gestrahlt und alle angerufen.
Meine Nachbarin hat mir Suppe gebracht, als ich krank war. Ich bin so dankbar für solche Menschen.
Ich saß lange mit Tee am Fenster. Alles war still und ruhig, ich fühle mich ganz entspannt.
Heute früh war ich schon laufen und fühle mich voller Energie. Ich könnte Bäume ausreißen!
Morgen ist die Präsentation und mein Herz rast. Ich kann nicht aufhören, an alles zu denken, was schiefgehen kann.
Abgabe, Umzug und Arztermine, alles gleichzeitig. Ich weiß nicht, wo ich anfangen soll, es ist zu viel.
Der Vermieter hat schon wieder nicht geantwortet. Ich bin so genervt, nichts geht voran.
Ich bin völlig erschöpft. Nach der Woche voller Schichten habe ich keine Kraft mehr.
Ich vermisse Papa heute so sehr. Ich habe seinen Schal gefunden und lange geweint.
Ich fühle gar nichts. Alle erwarten Trauer oder Freude, aber in mir ist nur Leere.
Das Gespräch lief gut. Ich glaube, dass sich jetzt endlich etwas zum Besseren wendet.
Ein ganz normaler, guter Tag. Gearbeitet, gekocht, gelesen. Mir fehlt nichts.
¡Vamos a tener un bebé! No he parado de sonreír en todo el día y llamé a todo el mundo.
Mi vecina me trajo sopa cuando estuve enferma. Estoy muy agradecida de tener gente así.
Me senté junto a la ventana con un té. Todo estaba en calma y me sentí muy tranquila.
Salí a correr al amanecer y tengo muchísima energía. Me siento imparable hoy.
Mañana es la presentación y me late el corazón a mil. No dejo de imaginar todo lo que puede salir mal.
Entrega, mudanza y citas médicas todo a la vez. No sé por dónde empezar, es demasiado.
El casero otra vez sin contestar. Estoy harto, nada avanza si no insisto yo.
Estoy agotado. Después de toda la semana de turnos no me queda ni una gota de energía.
Hoy echo mucho de menos a papá. Encontré su bufanda y lloré durante un buen rato.
No siento nada. Todos esperan que esté triste o contento, pero por dentro solo hay vacío.
La entrevista fue bien. Creo que por fin las cosas empiezan a mejorar y tengo ganas de lo que viene.
Un día normal y bueno. Trabajé, cociné y leí. No me falta nada.
